mapper.select:
SELECT a. STATUS, a.PROD_ID, a.PROD_NAME, a.START_DATE, a.CASH_TYPE_2, a.FEE_RATE, a.CREATE_USER, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.DATA_SOURCE FROM PRD_FEE_RATE_DATA a
not EXISTS ( SELECT 1 from DIS_PRD_FEE_RATE_ERRORDATA b where b.PROD_ID=a.PROD_ID and b.CASH_TYPE_2=a.CASH_TYPE_2 and b.START_DATE=a.START_DATE and b.STATUS in('A','E') )
and a.PROD_ID in(#{prodId})
and a.CASH_TYPE_2 in(#{cashType2})
and a.STATUS in(#{status})
union all
SELECT DISTINCT B.REG_CODE id, B.REG_CODE text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.REG_CODE is not null order by B.REG_CODE
SELECT A.REG_CODE regCode, A.ORG_CODE orgCode, A.PRODID prodId, A.PRODNAME prodname FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A INNER JOIN CHB_EQUDET_IMP_TMP B ON A.ORG_CODE = B.ORG_CODE AND A.PRODID = B.ACCOUNT
SELECT * FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.PRODID = #{prodid}

SELECT count(1) from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE where PRODID = #{prodid}
and ORG_CODE = #{orgCode}

SELECT DISTINCT A.REG_CODE id, IFNULL(b.prod_name,a.reg_code) text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A left join chb_prd_baseinfo b on b.prod_id = a.PRODID
A.REG_CODE is not null
and A.REG_CODE like concat_ws(concat_ws('%', #{search}),'%') or b.PROD_NAME like concat_ws(concat_ws('%', #{search}),'%')
#{orgCode}
ORDER BY A.REG_CODE
select PRODID prodId , REG_CODE regCode from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE

select PRODID prodId,REG_CODE regCode from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE
1=1
and PRODID = #{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by update_time desc

SELECT p.prod_id,p.prod_name FROM chb_prd_baseinfo p where p.status in ('E','M') and p.fprod_id is null
AND P.PROD_ID LIKE concat_ws(concat_ws('%', #{search}),'%')

SELECT p.PROD_INS_ID as prodInsId,p.prod_name FROM chb_prd_baseinfo p where p.status in ('E','M') and p.fprod_id is null
AND P.PROD_INS_ID LIKE concat_ws(concat_ws('%', #{search}),'%')

select chb_prd_baseinfo.PROD_NAME prodName, chb_prd_baseinfo.OPERATE_MODE operateMode, chb_prd_baseinfo.VDATE vdate, chb_prd_baseinfo.MDATE mdate from chb_prd_baseinfo left join FIN_PRODUCT on FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = chb_prd_baseinfo.PROD_ID where chb_prd_baseinfo.PROD_ID = #{prodId} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16'

select FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME prodName, REP_PROD_DECLARE.REP_OPERATE_MODE operateMode, FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.MDATE mdate from FIN_PRODUCT left join REP_PROD_DECLARE on REP_PROD_DECLARE.REP_FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{prodId} and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' and FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16'

select cpc.PRODID prodId from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE cpc
cpc.PRODID = #{prodId}
SELECT A.REG_CODE regCode FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A left join chb_prd_baseinfo b on b.prod_id = a.PRODID
mapper.insert: insert into SYS_UPLOAD_FILE_INFO (SEQ_NO, FILE_NAME, PATH, BUSINESS_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{path,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
